Specification: This module defines several operators to illustrate the use of primed variables, ENABLED expressions, and tuple/set constructions in TLA+. The variable y is the only state variable, and operators demonstrate both Leibniz and non-Leibniz contexts. There are no temporal properties, fairness conditions, or proofs present. The module serves as a minimal example for operator syntax and priming in TLA+.
